section.title: Trend Continuation Signals
section.text:
MAalign: price stacked against EMA20 / SMA20 / SMA50 (bullish / bearish / mixed). EMA5: 5-period exponential moving average. EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window. SMA200: 200-period simple moving average. dist_SMA200: % from current price to SMA200. ADX: 14-period average directional index (trend strength, 0–100). 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); ADX_trend = direction over the window. MACD: MACD histogram — the 12/26 line minus its 9-period signal. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); MACD_trend = direction over the window. MACD_cross: crossover event (Bullish / Bearish). RVOL: relative volume — the bar’s volume divided by its 20-period average, as a multiple (1.0 = at baseline, 2.0 = twice baseline). 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); RVOL_trend = direction over the window. OBV: on-balance volume — the running signed volume sum since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor, in base-asset units. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); closed bars only (the forming bar is excluded); OBV_trend = direction over the window.
